description: A methodology adapted from clinical psychology that jointly measures self-reported characteristics and observer-rated behavioral expressions of an LLM persona.

description: A reusable review workflow for assessing MCQ item quality: two content-expert evaluators independently rate each item against an evidence-based protocol of 15 item flaws, compare results, discuss disagreements and agree a final evaluation by consensus.
title: Dual-evaluator consensus protocol with quantitative flaw checks for reviewing MCQ quality
